_note: Two kinds of state live in this file. (1) `commands` / `agents` / `skills` / `hooks` / `templates_root_dirs` / `retention_commands` — DERIVABLE from the source tree. They are intentional drift catchers: bumping them is a deliberate PR-visible signal. Tests in tests/test_adapter_conformance.py re-count the source tree and assert equality. (2) `_mcp_legacy_baseline` — GENUINE ratchet state (not re-derivable). See its own inline `_note` for the ratchet semantics.

_mcp_legacy_baseline._note: Files in rendered adapter output that still mention legacy MCP server names (scholar-search-mcp, bib-manager-mcp, latex-build-mcp, code-intel-mcp, experiment-mcp, patent-search-mcp, external-agent-mcp). Invariant D is implemented as a ratchet: this set must not GROW. Removing files from the source/renderer that drop the legacy reference shrinks this set; tests will then flag the JSON as stale and force a contributor to tighten the baseline.
